text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Strange… I could've sworn I heard a voice just now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I thought it was someone from Ritto Dorm, but there's no one around.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Could it have been the statue of the Three Goddesses?
